cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort your lunch. Before you send this soup back, did you see anything moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm complaining about cold noodles. What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll order you a hot bowl. First, did one of those noodles wave?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It waved me closer. I'm still not eating it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ordered it lunch. Could you ask whether it wants your bread?

heightening.evidence: A5 already ordering food for the noodle reveals a larger prior commitment than merely noticing movement.
